body.x: CES 2019 Startup accepts applications from Korea’s representative start-ups. CES is the world's largest technology exhibition held every January in Las Vegas, USA, and it shows innovative technologies and issues every year, making CES an important platform for global launch of start-up.

Last year, CES 2018 attracted 180,000 visitors, 4,598 exhibitors, 1,018 start-ups from 45 countries, and 6,645 people. In particular, SMARTCITY, SPORTS & TECH, DESIGN & SOURCE IMERGE, and Smart Car have succeeded in bringing attention to the world with new categories. More than 1,000 start-ups from 45 countries participated in the Eureka Park, a CES start-up business zone that attracts investors, media and participating companies from around the world.
(Picture: Korea had the third largest participant among the 20 participating countries. 7,197 participants participated)

In 2019, all of the exhibition centers in Eureka Park will be used to expand the scale, and global companies and investors will be enthusiastically looking for new technologies and investments through this start-up. CES Eureka Park is growing by more than 30% every year and is participating in a joint project in countries that actively support start-ups. France is expanding every year, and in 2019 it is expected to be located in the center of the Eureka Park main entrance of 170 companies in the form of a common hall in CES.

AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met.
MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
(Please contact GMEG for further inquiries regarding institutional and company participation.)
